programme.title: Guinness Greatness: Harlem Globetrotters in the Record Books
programme.desc: Get ready for jaw-dropping, record breaking trick shots as the world famous Harlem Globetrotters set out to break numerous Guinness World Records.

programme.title: Celebrities Ep. 6
programme.desc: The Globetrotters spend the day with YouTuber Faze Rug.

programme.title: Precision Perfect Unreal Trick Shots
programme.desc: From rooftop buckets to no-look swishes, witness a masterclass in creativity, control, and jaw-dropping precision. No CGI. No second takes. Just raw talent and unbelievable trick shots that push the limits of what's possible.

programme.title: Cooking with STEAM
programme.desc: Hammer, Hotshot, Torch, and Coach Lou visit a youth football league in South LA to learn how the coaches are inspiring the community. TNT, Cheese, and Hotshot visit an organization that teaches kids the values of Science, Technology, Engineering, Art, and Math. Torch travels to Malaysia with Scooter to connect with some special locals. Plus, Jet brings Cheese, Hotshot, and Hops to an LA Shelter to cook for their residents.

programme.title: Swimming With Whale Sharks
programme.desc: Bulldog, Wham, and TNT join wounded veterans for an extraordinary encounter with whale sharks in Atlanta. Torch and Jet get in the groove as they join a special art education program to remix the Globetrotter theme song. Cheese heads home to the Bronx to revisit his roots. Hosted by Craig Robinson.

programme.title: The Garden State
programme.desc: Hammer, Cheese, and TNT trade in the wood-grain for the ice rink in Chicago. Jet, Hotshot, and Cheese encourage literacy in Harlem. Hammer shares the inspirational story of his childhood injury and how he recovered. Hosted by Craig Robinson.

programme.title: Dunks Ep. 3
programme.desc: The best dunks from the Harlem Globetrotters.

programme.title: Chicago 2019
programme.desc: All the dunks, alley-oops, looooong shots, magic, history and laughs from the world-famous Harlem Globetrotters. This game was played in Chicago, IL in 2019.

programme.title: Trick Shots Ep. 3
programme.desc: Amazing trick shots from the Harlem Globetrotters.

programme.title: Celebrities Ep. 4
programme.desc: A collection of celebrity interactions with the Harlem Globetrotters including sports columnist Matthew Berry, NBA stars Jason Kidd and Dirk Nowitzki, and rapper Snoop Dogg.

programme.title: Worthy of Praise
programme.desc: Coach Lou celebrates one of the best Globetrotters of all time: Geese Ausbie; the team breaks bread with a Los Angeles-based group providing birthday parties to kids experiencing homelessness; Thunder breaks down the science behind a trick shot.

programme.title: Blazing Ahead
programme.desc: TNT and Torch reminisce on their early days of blazing the trail for a new generation of female Globetrotters; the team visits an Atlanta organization that cultivates Paralympian athletes and a New Orleans program that mentors kids through music.

programme.title: Game On! Dunk, Shoot, Win!
programme.desc: The female Globetrotters throughout the years, Globie gets in on the action, world records and more Globetrotter magic!

programme.title: On The Waterfront
programme.desc: Bulldog joins Jet and his daughter to discover the secrets of marine conservation at Hampton Beach. Then, TNT alongside Jet and his daughter realize just how precious the simple things are on the shores of Sebago Lake. And Thunder proves his vertical lift is as impressive as ever. Kenny Smith Hosts.

programme.title: Minneapolis 2024
programme.desc: All the dunks, alley-oops, looooong shots, magic, history and laughs from the world-famous Harlem Globetrotters. This game was played in the Target Center in Minneapolis, MN.

programme.title: Trick Shots Ep. 5
programme.desc: Amazing trick shots from the Harlem Globetrotters.

programme.title: Blast Off!
programme.desc: Jet, Wham, and Hotshot teach some South Central LA youth about the benefits of sports and exercise. Cheese and TNT visit NASA's Kennedy Space Center to learn how teamwork gets a rocket to the moon and back. And Bulldog shares a tribute to his most important mentor and inspiration: his older brother. Hosted by Craig Robinson.

programme.title: Show & Sail
programme.desc: The Globetrotters travel to Chicago to learn about organizations that teach diversity in the sport of sailing; they head to Topeka, Kan. and the history of the Showman.

programme.title: My Globetrotter Journey Begins
programme.desc: From the nerves of the first game to the thrill of the first no-look bucket, experience the grind, the glory, and the global stage of becoming a Harlem Globetrotter.

programme.title: Honorable Adventures
programme.desc: The team highlights their greatest showmen. The Harlem Globetrotters perform for servicemen and their families during a visit to Moody Air Force Base. Plus, Hammer surprises viral sensation Zeke "The Trick Shot Kid." Cheese, Wham, Hammer, and Hotshot learn about some amazing animals at a theme park in Georgia.

programme.title: Going for the Gold
programme.desc: Torch, Hotshot and Thunder visit an Atlanta organization that has cultivated some very special Paralympian athletes. Wham, Too Tall and Torch team up with gymnast Nia Dennis to inspire a diverse group of young gymnasts in Pasadena. Coach Lou, Thunder and Torch reflect on the Globetrotters’ storied history of setting world records. And Kevin DeBruin reveals the science behind one of Torch’s amazing trick shots. Kenny Smith hosts.

programme.title: Willing and Able
programme.desc: Hotshot takes Wham to an aquarium in Kentucky that preserves aquatic wildlife. Hotshot, Cheese, and Jet learn about an organization that builds playgrounds for kids of all abilities. Hammer tours his adopted hometown of Tampa, and he connects with Coach Handles to mentor young athletes. Plus, Thunder reunites with a very special fan.

programme.title: Community Compassion
programme.desc: Torch and Cheese learn about the importance of mentorship for teens in the tech industry. Wham, Bulldog, and Hotshot fulfill a major need for a south central Los Angeles after-school program. Bulldog, Jet, and Hotshot learn about the value of financial literacy while discovering the game of golf. Cheese heads home to the Bronx to revisit his roots.

programme.title: Slammin' Street Ball
programme.desc: The Globetrotters learn the benefits of verse with "Street Poets." The team tells their history of being goodwill ambassadors. Plus, they surprise coach and mentor Chris "Handles" Franklin by honoring him at his community event in Harrisburg, PA.

programme.title: Sweet Georgia Brown
programme.desc: Thunder invites Jet and Bulldog to Red Hot Chili Pepper Flea’s Conservatory of Music to discover how he keeps the study of music alive for the kids of LA. TNT and Thunder visit Speedy at a local community center to learn about his youth basketball league and train some special athletes. And the science behind Jet’s Granny Shot taken at Harlem’s world-famous Rucker Park. Kenny Smith hosts.

programme.title: The Sweet Lou Dunbar Story
programme.desc: Celebrate the incredible story of Sweet Lou Dunbar, a Harlem Globetrotters legend whose talent, charisma, and creativity helped define generations of show basketball. From his rise as a gifted player to his lasting impact as a showman, coach, and mentor, this special episode honors the man whose joy, leadership, and legacy continue to inspire players and fans around the world.

programme.title: Dancing is good for the Soul
programme.desc: TNT and Thunder visit Speedy to learn about his youth basketball league and train some special athletes. TNT and Ace dance their way into the hearts of a group of young girls in Harlem. Thunder and Bulldog line dance their way into the hearts of an amazing community in Nashville. And Speedy hits the famous courts of Harlem's Rucker Park to break down a one-of-a-kind trick shot. Kenny Smith hosts.

programme.title: Making the Cut
programme.desc: Tryouts for new Globetrotter Team Members are underway. Who will make the cut? Meanwhile, Jet, Wham, and Hotshot teach some South Central LA youth about the benefits of sports and exercise. And, the Globetrotters pay tribute to their legendary teammate Meadowlark Lemon.

programme.title: Yes You Can!
programme.desc: Hammer, Bulldog, and TNT travel to Phoenix to help empower and motivate local youth at a renowned afterschool program. Bulldog, Jet, and Hotshot learn about the value of financial literacy while discovering the game of golf. Globetrotter Max 'Hops' Pearce unveils his unique artwork. TNT gets help from Wham in her search for a family dog. Hosted by Craig Robinson.

programme.title: Globetrotters History Ep. 1
programme.desc: Celebrating the legacy of the Harlem Globetrotters with iconic profiles and unforgettable moments as we journey through decades of dazzling skills, humor, and global impact.

programme.title: Trotters of the Caribbean
programme.desc: The Globetrotters visit a school in the Dominican Republic teaching kids the virtues of harvesting their own crops, recount the history of their beloved "magic circle".

programme.title: American Dream East Rutherford 2024
programme.desc: All the dunks, alley-oops, looooong shots, magic, history and laughs from the world-famous Harlem Globetrotters. This game was played at the American Dream in East Rutherford, NJ.

programme.title: Good Eats
programme.desc: Cheese, Bulldog, Hot Shot, and Jet meet with local D.C. youth to support their mission for clean water and self-reliance. TNT, Torch, Wham, and Hammer learn about cooking nutritious meals through a healthy competition. Thunder and the Globetrotters perform for a special crowd in Chile and meet with the Chilean Minister of Sports and a deserving group of local children. TNT supports Torch from the sidelines of one of the fastest growing sports for women, flag football.

programme.title: The Need for Speed
programme.desc: The Globetrotters twist into formation as they learn the historic tradition of Cuban Ballet in Miami. The team then meets the first professional female pit mechanic of color at a racing school before being invited to see her in action at a race in Indianapolis.

programme.desc: Amazing trick shots from the Harlem Globetrotters.

programme.title: Green Bay 2023
programme.desc: All the dunks, alley-oops, looooong shots, magic, history and laughs from the world-famous Harlem Globetrotters. This game was played in The Resch Center in Ashwaubenon, WI.

programme.desc: Torch, Ace and TNT mentor a special group of girls in Atlanta. TNT and Ace dance their way into the hearts of a group of young girls in Harlem. And we break down the mechanics of a spectacular trick shot taken by Ace in Tennessee. Kenny Smith hosts.

programme.desc: Wham, Cheese and Hammer learn about the construction industry; Torch, Hammer, and Hot Shot head to Broward, Florida, to meet The Embrace Girls Foundation; a nonprofit encouraging at-risk girls and uplifting tea parties.; Thunder throwback to his trick shot gauntlet at an abandoned warehouse.; Torch, Hammer, Wham, and Hot Shot take an unforgettable journey to Australia. programme.desc: Torch, Hotshot and Thunder visit an Atlanta organization that has cultivated some very special Paralympian athletes. Coach Lou, Thunder and Torch reflect on the Globetrotters’ storied history of setting world records. And Kevin DeBruin reveals the science behind one of Torch’s amazing trick shots. Kenny Smith hosts.

programme.title: Home Court Advantage
programme.desc: Wham visits an organization that supports veterans to surprise his cousin Ira with a skydiving experience. Bulldog visits his hometown of Corpus Christi where he, Hotshot, Hammer, and Coach Lou challenge Little Brothers and Little Sisters to an unforgettable game of basketball. Thunder and Hot Rod visit a school in the Dominican Republic that teaches kids the virtues of harvesting their own crops.

programme.title: Art in the Jet
programme.desc: The Globetrotters join a special program that is revitalizing inner city basketball courts. Cheese gets a galactic lesson on what it takes to prepare food for zero gravity. Jet comes in for a landing in his hometown of Elizabeth, New Jersey, where he gives back at a youth basketball camp. And Wham breaks the world record for most between-the-leg dribbles in one minute. Hosted by Craig Robinson.

programme.title: The Gifted Givers
programme.desc: TNT, Cheese, and Hotshot visit an organization that teaches kids the values of Science, Technology, Engineering, Art, and Math. Hammer tours his adopted hometown of Tampa where he connects with Coach Handles and mentors young athletes. Cheese, Wham, Hammer, and Hotshot learn about some amazing animals at a theme park in Georgia. Plus Coach Lou helps Thunder brush up on his Spanish before heading on tour to Mexico.

programme.title: Old School
programme.desc: The team dazzles in Santo Domingo.

programme.title: Celebrities Ep. 6
programme.desc: The Globetrotters spend the day with YouTuber Faze Rug.

programme.title: Breaking Boundaries And World Records
programme.desc: The women of the Harlem Globetrotters. Plus, jaw-dropping trick shots, slick handles, and unstoppable energy from the Harlem Globetrotters.

programme.title: Trick Shots Ep. 8
programme.desc: Amazing trick shots from the Harlem Globetrotters.

programme.title: The Art of the Game
programme.desc: TNT spends time with family in her adopted hometown of Charlotte, NC; Hot Shot takes Wham to an aquarium in Kentucky that preserves aquatic wildlife. Coaches Lou and Handles help players cultivate their skills at the annual Showman’s camp in Atlanta.

programme.title: Urban Farming
programme.desc: A young man's life is changed forever when he overcomes bullying with the encouragement from the team. Wham and Hammer venture off the court and on to the farm to learn valuable skills in food cultivation and healthy living. TNT, Torch, Wham, and Hammer get a history lesson from Coach Lou when he puts a twist on a classic playground game of, Knockout.

programme.title: Nourish the Body
programme.desc: The Globetrotters partake in a cooking competition with world-renowned chef, Marcus Samuelson. Thunder and Hammer head to a gym with the goal of providing adaptive athletes a place to workout the body and soul. Then Coach Lou, Thunder and Torch reflect on the Globetrotters' storied history of setting world records. And we break down the science behind Cheese's famous Granny shot. Kenny Smith hosts.

programme.title: Homecoming
programme.desc: Torch and Jet get in the groove as they join a special art education program to remix the Globetrotters' theme song. Coach Lou joins Hammer, Bulldog, and the team to learn about the history and legacy of the Harlem Globetrotters from their humble beginnings in Chicago. The Globetrotters help a deserving family win a brand new micro-home.

programme.title: Dallas 2024
programme.desc: All the dunks, alley-oops, looooong shots, magic, history and laughs from the world-famous Harlem Globetrotters. This game was played in the American Airlines Center in Dallas, TX.

programme.title: Celebrities Ep. 1
programme.desc: The Harlem Globetrotters have fun with celebrity athletes, actors and influencers including the Dallas Mavericks of the NBA, former MLB player David Ross MLS player Alejandro Bedoya and ESPN commentator David Pollack.

programme.title: Aussie! Aussie! Aussie! Oi! Oi! Oi!
programme.desc: Globetrotters, Wham and TNT, pay homage to the legendary Coach Lou; Torch, Hammer, Wham, and Hot Shot take an unforgettable journey to Australia. Wham and Hammer venture off the court and on to the farm to learn valuable skills in food cultivation and healthy living.

programme.title: Hope Floats
programme.desc: Torch and Bulldog learn the benefits of Equine therapy at "Shining Hope Farms." Hammer, Torch, Bulldog and Ace travel to Chicago to learn about two organizations that teach diversity in the sport of sailing. Hotshot and Cheese hit the court in LA to challenge some locals to a pickup game.

programme.title: Globetrotters History Ep. 3
programme.desc: Celebrating the legacy of the Harlem Globetrotters with iconic profiles and unforgettable moments as we journey through decades of dazzling skills, humor, and global impact.

programme.title: My Rookie Season Ep. 3
programme.desc: The annual Harlem Globetrotters Training Camp welcomes new rookies while fans get a look behind the curtain to see what it takes to make the team and what it truly means to be a Harlem Globetrotter.

programme.title: Celebrities Ep. 6
programme.desc: The Globetrotters spend the day with YouTuber Faze Rug.

programme.title: Good Eats
programme.desc: Cheese, Bulldog, Hot Shot, and Jet meet with local D.C. youth to support their mission for clean water and self-reliance. TNT, Torch, Wham, and Hammer learn about cooking nutritious meals through a healthy competition. Thunder and the Globetrotters perform for a special crowd in Chile and meet with the Chilean Minister of Sports and a deserving group of local children. TNT supports Torch from the sidelines of one of the fastest growing sports for women, flag football.

programme.title: New Teammates
programme.desc: Coach Lou joins Hammer, Bulldog, and the team to learn about the history and legacy of the Harlem Globetrotters from their humble beginnings in Chicago. Tryouts for new Globetrotter Team Members are underway and the Globetrotters remember some of their favorite places from around the world. Hosted by Craig Robinson.

programme.title: Honorable Adventures
programme.desc: The team highlights their greatest showmen. The Harlem Globetrotters perform for servicemen and their families during a visit to Moody Air Force Base. Plus, Hammer surprises viral sensation Zeke "The Trick Shot Kid." Cheese, Wham, Hammer, and Hotshot learn about some amazing animals at a theme park in Georgia.

programme.title: Making the Cut
programme.desc: Tryouts for new Globetrotter Team Members are underway. Who will make the cut? Meanwhile, Jet, Wham, and Hotshot teach some South Central LA youth about the benefits of sports and exercise. And, the Globetrotters pay tribute to their legendary teammate Meadowlark Lemon.

programme.title: My Rookie Season Ep. 3
programme.desc: The annual Harlem Globetrotters Training Camp welcomes new rookies while fans get a look behind the curtain to see what it takes to make the team and what it truly means to be a Harlem Globetrotter.

programme.title: A Routine Haircut
programme.desc: Wham, Too Tall and Torch team up with gymnast Nia Dennis to inspire a diverse group of young gymnasts in Pasadena; Speedy invites Thunder and Bulldog to his hometown of Philadelphia to give back to a barber who provides haircuts to the homeless.

programme.title: Celebrities Ep. 3
programme.desc: A collection of celebrity interactions with the Harlem Globetrotters including actresses Reese Witherspoon and Julie Bowen, quarterback Ben Roethlisberger and punter Marquette King.

programme.title: My Rookie Season Ep. 1
programme.desc: The annual Harlem Globetrotters Training Camp welcomes new rookies and fans get a look behind the curtain to see what it takes to make the team and what it truly means to be a Harlem Globetrotter.

programme.title: Blast Off!
programme.desc: Jet, Wham, and Hotshot teach some South Central LA youth about the benefits of sports and exercise. Cheese and TNT visit NASA's Kennedy Space Center to learn how teamwork gets a rocket to the moon and back. And Bulldog shares a tribute to his most important mentor and inspiration: his older brother. Hosted by Craig Robinson.

programme.desc: Amazing trick shots from the Harlem Globetrotters.

programme.title: S1E1 Tour
programme.desc: Pursuing the Tour de France, one of the most physically demanding sporting events in the world, covers over 3,535 kilometers in just three weeks. Every young cyclist dreams of competing in this prestigious race, but only nine riders from each team make the cut. Young cyclist Adam Yates is giving everything he has to prove he belongs on cycling’s biggest stage. 2016 Tour de France winner Chris Froome reflects on the long and grueling journey to victory, while former professional cyclists and Tour de France veterans Jens Voigt, Christian Vande Velde, and Haimar Zubeldia reveal what it truly takes to compete at the highest level.

programme.title: S1E1 Driven
programme.desc:
GoPro Motorsports Original Series DRIVEN takes you deep inside the world of Supercross and Motocross champion James Stewart. Ride alongside the man known as the fastest on two wheels as he shares the highs, lows, and relentless drive that shaped his legendary career.
GoPro Original Series DRIVEN also follows X Games star and snowmobile icon Chris Burandt. Join him on a thrilling journey to discover what fuels his passion and dedication to the lifestyle he has loved since childhood. This is raw, high-octane storytelling you can’t miss.

programme.title: S1E2 Driven
programme.desc: In this episode of GoPro Original Series DRIVEN, we continue our in-depth look at X Games star and snowmobile legend Chris Burandt. Join him on an adrenaline-fueled journey to uncover what drives his passion and dedication to the lifestyle he has loved since childhood. The second part goes inside the life of three-time NASCAR Cup Series Champion and Daytona 500 winner Joey Logano. Watch as he pushes the limits on the track and discovers how he uses his racing platform to make a difference in the lives of others.

programme.title: S1E3 Driven
programme.desc: Three-time NASCAR Cup Series Champion and Daytona 500 winner Joey Logano continues to push the limits on the track while finding new ways to use his racing platform to make a positive impact on others. In this episode of GoPro Motorsports Original Series DRIVEN, step into the world of DC Shoes co-founder, rally car driver, and marketing mastermind Ken Block. Strap in for an electrifying journey through the moments and passions that have fueled his remarkable career.

programme.title: S1E1 Draft Story
programme.desc: In Part 1, we uncover the story of Tyvis Powell and the people who shaped him into the man and football player he is today. His road to the NFL was anything but easy, and it nearly never happened without the guidance of his mentor, Sean Williams. A Draft Story is a GoPro Original Production that follows Ohio State safety Tyvis Powell as he makes the leap to professional football. Though he was not invited to Chicago for the 2016 NFL Draft, his journey is unforgettable. Witness the tension, hope, and emotion as Tyvis waits for the call that will change his life and etch the Powell name into NFL history. This is his Draft Story.

programme.title: S1 E2 Draft Story
programme.desc: A Draft Story” Part 2 is a GoPro Original Production that follows Ohio State safety Tyvis Powell as he takes the leap into professional football. Facing unexpected challenges, honoring a promise to local kids, and navigating a situation he never imagined, Tyvis proves that the journey to the NFL is full of twists, heart, and determination.

programme.title: S1E1 The Jackson Goldstone Story
programme.desc: Beyond Limits: The Jackson Goldstone Story is an electrifying YouTube series that follows mountain biking sensation Jackson Goldstone through his 2023 UCI Downhill World Championship season. Watch as he pushes his limits on some of the most dangerous downhill courses in the world, from steep, rocky descents to twisting forest trails, attacking every challenge with unmatched skill and determination. Go behind the scenes to see the intense training sessions, precise bike tuning, and mental preparation that fuel his success. Experience the rush of high-stakes racing with heart-pounding runs, fierce rivalries, and moments that will keep you holding your breath. More than just the action, Beyond Limits reveals Jackson’s personal journey, the sacrifices he makes for his passion, and the powerful support network that drives him forward. This is the ultimate inside look at a world-class athlete chasing glory on two wheels.

Watch as he pushes his limits on some of the most dangerous downhill courses in the world, from steep, rocky descents to twisting forest trails, attacking every challenge with unmatched skill and determination. Go behind the scenes to see the intense training sessions, precise bike tuning, and mental preparation that fuel his success. Experience the rush of high-stakes racing with heart-pounding runs, fierce rivalries, and moments that will keep you holding your breath. More than just the action, Beyond Limits reveals Jackson’s personal journey, the sacrifices he makes for his passion, and the powerful support network that drives him forward. This is the ultimate inside look at a world-class athlete chasing glory on two wheels.

programme.title: S1E1 Animals
programme.desc: GoPro Animals delivers heartwarming, hilarious, and jaw-dropping moments from the animal world. From Golden Retrievers, French Bulldogs, and Border Collies bringing endless puppy smiles, to rescuing orcas and swimming with humpback whales, this show has it all. Wildlife photographer Chris Barnard captures the wild up close, even surviving a giraffe’s mighty kick. Plus, join Ocean Conservation Namibia as they race to save seals trapped in deadly ocean debris. A must-watch for every animal lover.

programme.title: S1E1 Two Roads
programme.desc:
“Two Roads” is an original GoPro series that follows nine athletes and one coach who have committed themselves to the relentless pursuit of greatness. Each episode dives deep into an athlete’s unique journey, revealing the life-changing moments that shaped the path they walk today.
This episode features Olympic bronze medalist Kristian Ipsen, American rugby union star Carlin Isles — celebrated as “The Fastest Man in Rugby” — and his remarkable rise from track and field and American football to becoming a two-time Olympian in rugby sevens. You’ll also meet Allison Stokke, a record-breaking high school pole vaulter who went on to compete at UC Berkeley, and Miles Chamley-Watson, a British-American fencing champion whose career includes 13 team Pan American titles, a 2019 team world championship, a 2013 individual world championship, three Olympic appearances, and a 2016 team Olympic bronze medal.

programme.title: S1E2 Two Roads
programme.desc: “Two Roads” is an original GoPro series that follows nine athletes and one coach who have committed themselves to the relentless pursuit of greatness. Each episode dives deep into an athlete’s unique journey, revealing the life-changing moments that shaped the path they walk today. This episode features Trenten Merrill, an American Paralympic long jumper who claimed bronze at the 2020 Summer Paralympics. Also featured is Casey Patterson, a powerhouse in professional beach volleyball with numerous AVP tournament wins, a gold medal on the FIVB World Tour, and an appearance at the 2016 Rio Olympics alongside Jake Gibb. Tennis legends Bob and Mike Bryan, the most successful doubles team in history, take the spotlight with 16 Grand Slam titles, 119 ATP Tour doubles victories, 438 weeks as the world’s No. 1 team, and Olympic gold in 2012. Rounding out the episode is acclaimed gymnastics coach Liang Chow, celebrated for guiding Gabby Douglas to the 2012 Olympic all-around gold and coaching Shawn Johnson to multiple medals at the 2008 Olympics.

programme.title: S1E3 Two Roads
programme.desc: “Two Roads” is an original GoPro series that follows nine athletes and one coach who have committed themselves to the relentless pursuit of greatness. Each episode dives deep into an athlete’s unique journey, revealing the life-changing moments that shaped the path they walk today. This episode features Paul Rabil, legendary professional lacrosse player and co-founder of the Premier Lacrosse League, celebrated as one of the greatest in the sport’s history. Also featured is Britney Henry, a standout track and field athlete from the University of Oregon who captured the Pac-10 Conference title in the hammer throw. Rounding out the episode is Meagan Martin, trailblazing competitor as the first female rookie to complete the American Ninja Warrior course and the first-ever Women’s Champion of the series.

programme.title: S1E1 Draft Story
programme.desc: In Part 1, we uncover the story of Tyvis Powell and the people who shaped him into the man and football player he is today. His road to the NFL was anything but easy, and it nearly never happened without the guidance of his mentor, Sean Williams. A Draft Story is a GoPro Original Production that follows Ohio State safety Tyvis Powell as he makes the leap to professional football. Though he was not invited to Chicago for the 2016 NFL Draft, his journey is unforgettable. Witness the tension, hope, and emotion as Tyvis waits for the call that will change his life and etch the Powell name into NFL history. This is his Draft Story.

programme.title: S1 E2 Draft Story
programme.desc: A Draft Story” Part 2 is a GoPro Original Production that follows Ohio State safety Tyvis Powell as he takes the leap into professional football. Facing unexpected challenges, honoring a promise to local kids, and navigating a situation he never imagined, Tyvis proves that the journey to the NFL is full of twists, heart, and determination.

programme.title: S1E1 Tour
programme.desc: Pursuing the Tour de France, one of the most physically demanding sporting events in the world, covers over 3,535 kilometers in just three weeks. Every young cyclist dreams of competing in this prestigious race, but only nine riders from each team make the cut. Young cyclist Adam Yates is giving everything he has to prove he belongs on cycling’s biggest stage. 2016 Tour de France winner Chris Froome reflects on the long and grueling journey to victory, while former professional cyclists and Tour de France veterans Jens Voigt, Christian Vande Velde, and Haimar Zubeldia reveal what it truly takes to compete at the highest level.

programme.desc: GoPro Bike takes you to the world’s most extreme mountain biking adventures. Watch Geoff Gulevich, trail master, tackle some of the gnarliest chutes in Williams Lake, BC, dropping in with local legend Cory Brunelle, downhill expert. Then experience some of the best riders from around the globe as they conquer massive mountains, perform jaw-dropping tricks, and push the limits of skill and adrenaline in breathtaking terrain.

programme.title: S3E1 Bike
programme.desc: GoPro Bike takes you on epic, boundary-pushing adventures. Watch GoPro athlete Kilian Bron, trail innovator, team up with big-mountain skier Victor Broquedis, powder champion, in Peru as they summit Cerro Blanco, the world-record 3,860-foot dune, and ride unforgettable downhill mountain bike and ski runs. Then experience some of the best riders from around the globe as they conquer massive mountains, perform jaw-dropping tricks, and push the limits of skill, speed, and adrenaline.

programme.title: S3E2 Bike
programme.desc: GoPro Bike brings you heart-pounding downhill action from the Mountain of Hell in Les Alpes, France. Watch GoPro athlete Antoni Villoni, downhill master, as he navigates crashes, weaves through expert trails, and powers down 7,800 vertical feet of snow-capped peaks, dusty singletracks, and technical terrain. Hundreds of riders take on this epic race, where only speed, skill, and courage decide who reaches the finish line first. The rules are simple: first one to cross the line wins...

programme.title: S4E1 Bike
programme.desc: When the sun sets, GoPro Awards recipient Nikolaj Juhlsen lights up the Austrian forest on his downhill mountain bike, GoPro MAX mounted and headlamp blazing. Watch Jonny Livorti take on a daring staircase ride overlooking the Italian Riviera, where speed, finesse, and bravery are essential for this epic descent in Liguria, Italy. Why hike when you can mountain bike? Experience jaw-dropping trails, fearless riders, and the ultimate daredevil MTB action.

programme.title: S1E2 Moto

Ride along with GoPro Family members Carlos and Alex Costa as they experience vibrant cities, breathtaking beaches, and the adventure of a lifetime. Plus, enjoy bonus footage of Jeremy Seewer. With 50 podiums, 11 victories, 17 race wins, and five FIM Motocross World Championship silver medals, his record is remarkable — yet his story goes far beyond the numbers.

programme.desc: Celebrate the women of GoPro, including British rally driver Catie Munnings, who rose to fame after winning the FIA European Rally Championship Ladies Trophy at just 18. Watch snowboarder Alina Hight who made history as the first to land a double backside alley-oop rodeo in a halfpipe competition. Meet Teigan Nash, co-founder of Girls Who Glow, inspiring young women everywhere. Plus, experience even more of the very best from GoPro Motorsports.

programme.desc: GoPro Athlete and Formula 1 star Daniel Ricciardo teams up with Race Service Co-Founder James Kirkham for an unforgettable ride through Los Angeles. With eight Grand Prix victories and 32 podiums to his name, the Honey Badger spends his day off behind the wheel of supercars like the Ford GT, racing past Beverly Hills, the Sunset Strip, and into the winding roads of Benedict Canyon. Plus, enjoy even more of the very best from GoPro Motorsports.

programme.title: S1E1 El Nino
programme.desc: Chasing El Niño follows Chris Benchetler on an epic skiing adventure from California’s Mammoth Mountain and the Sierra Nevada backcountry to the vast slopes of British Columbia. Joined by longtime friends Bryan Fox, Scotty Smith, and Canadian pro skier Nick McNutt, Chris explores previously inaccessible terrain, searches for perfect powder, and faces challenging weather conditions. Along the way, the crew embraces the joy of skiing, building creative jumps at their campsite and making the most of every moment on the mountain. This episode captures the thrill of exploration, friendship, and the relentless pursuit of epic lines.

programme.title: S1E2 El Nino
programme.desc: Chris Benchetler continues his epic skiing adventure from California’s Mammoth Mountain and the Sierra Nevada backcountry to the massive slopes of British Columbia. This time, X Games gold medalist Jossi Wells joins him for "The Sierra Trifecta," tackling skiing, climbing, and biking all in a single day. Chris and his crew hike 6,000 vertical feet through rugged rock fields to chase the last snow of the season in the Sierras, pushing their limits and capturing every thrilling moment.

programme.title: Goin' Coastal
programme.desc: Join the Mayor of Destin as he ventures into the world of coastal fishing, leaving the city behind for a day of fun and unexpected challenges. With plenty of laughs and surprising twists, this episode showcases the Mayor in a whole new light.

programme.title: Goin' Coastal
programme.desc: Join Josh Calhoon on Goin’ Coastal TV as he takes Big Gus on one of the most epic topwater bites ever caught on camera!

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff venture deep into Maine’s backcountry with their buddy Chuck, ice fishing remote lakes only reachable by snowmobile. Their journey ends at the legendary “ghost trains,” a pair of abandoned locomotives that now rest as silent monuments to a forgotten logging era.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff wade into the flooded timber of the legendary Coca-Cola Woods, where mallards drop through the treetops in waves. Amidst echoes of calling and wingbeats, they experience one of America’s most iconic duck hunts.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff scour the rugged mountains of southern Arizona in search of the elusive Coues deer, known to hunters as the “Grey Ghost.” Through scorching sun and shifting winds, they test their skill and patience chasing one of North America’s most elusive big game animals.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: The Green Way team continue their African journey with hunts for both the majestic Kudu and elusive Golden Wildebeest. The experience comes full circle when the meat from these animals is donated to local schoolchildren, who receive not only fresh meals but also school supplies and sweets that light up the village.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Through the rugged terrain of South Africa's Northern Cape, Mark Peterson sets out in pursuit of a rare and thrilling double, the Axis and Fallow Deer. Though non-native, these species have flourished in the region's diverse habitat. Join Mark on this unforgettable experience under the African skies, during this unique hunting experience in South Africa.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Continuing on with his quest for The North America Deer Slam, Mark Peterson packs his Gunwerks Nexus 300 PRC rifle for a hunt in Mexico targeting the elusive Mexican Texanus Whitetail from elevated blinds. The outfitter here has done an amazing job managing the deer numbers and age groups to grow giant whitetails. Mark is anticipating the pre-rut will get these big bucks moving.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: The Vaal Reedbuck is one of the most elusive plains game animals in Africa. Known for their incredible eyesight and nervous nature, they rarely stick around once spotted. On this hunt in South Africa’s Eastern Cape, Mark Peterson sets out into rugged hill country and open grasslands in pursuit of one of these wary antelope.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Mark Peterson sets his sights on a Free-Range New Zealand Red Stag, but it doesn't come easy. Dense fog, steep terrain, and thick vegetation make finding a mature stag no easy task. Watch as Mark Peterson and his guide cover the gorgeous New Zealand landscape in search of one of the most sought-after big game animals on the South Island of New Zealand. On this hunt, Mark was unable to get his firearms import permit in time to take his Gunwerks rifle, so he'd again have to borrow from his guide.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: This hunt tells a story in two parts. The first chapter follows Earl Peterson, Mark’s dad, as he steps into the field with one specific goal in mind. Experience, patience, and timing all play a role as the morning unfolds, setting the tone for the rest of the adventure. The second chapter shifts to Mark’s turn. On the coldest morning of the trip so far, the team heads into black-faced impala country. Wind, shifting conditions, and sharp eyes keep things interesting as they cover ground and look for the right opportunity. Every move matters, and nothing comes easy.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Mark Peterson and his father Earl have spent six thrilling days immersed in the wilds of Tanzania, exploring the heart of Africa. Next on their adventure, they set out to hunt the elusive Chandler's Mountain Reed buck. However, the raging river poses a formidable challenge, making it too dangerous to cross. Undeterred, they adapt by using alternative means of transportation. Armed with their trusty Gunwerks rifles, they navigate the rugged terrain, determined to get close to these elusive creatures amidst the stunning and challenging landscape.

programme.title: Bearded Buck

Not many of us can say that, nor understand what that truly means. The things they've had to see, and the sacrifices they've made in their daily lives, can have a profound impact on them. Trinity Oaks' Bucks for the Brave platform allows the loved ones and communities that support these heroes to share their stories and unite us all in honoring and recognizing their service to our great nation. programme.title: Off-Road Travel TV
programme.desc: The team travels to Montana to go snow biking in this winter paradise, then heads to Colorado to go on an unforgettable dirt bike tour. We also test a Cherokee Gray Wolf Black Label 22RRBL toy hauler and take it on a cross-country road trip.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - DISCOVERIES IN JERSEY
programme.desc: Ray explores buying a unique, hand built car the Schultz family has kept in their New Jersey home for years. The car was originally called the Schultz El Fierro but it’s officially titled in New Jersey as a “Schultz Special” from 1958. It was used to drag race and held numerous racing records, but most important to the family was that it was driven by the legendary Carroll Shelby. With a frame and style much similar to the Shelby Roadster, the Schultz family wonders if it inspired one of the most well known automobiles in America. In another epic New Jersey story, Ray finds Mario Andretti’s 1965 IndyCar. The catch: it’s completely in pieces hidden away in a garage. The iconic driver talks about his days on the track with that car and Ray attempts to negotiate a deal to buy the parts.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - BREAK UP TO MAKEUP
programme.desc: From break up to make up, Jeff Gordon and Ray reunite to go on a quest to find their Chevrolet Monte Carlo that claimed victory in their final race together at Phoenix, AZ in 1999. John Bickford, Jeff Gordon’s stepdad, makes the call that reunites the old team. Jeff and Ray look to bum parts off their boss, Rick Hendrick, to make their vision a reality: get the car, replace the parts as they were, make it run and get it to auction.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - MOVIE CARS
programme.desc: How do you cast a car in a movie? What are the secrets to the build? Hollywood car designers give Ray the ultimate tour of some memorable movie cars, including a look at the recently found “Hells Chariot”, the last surviving car from Grease. We also hear the backstory to “Bumble Bee” from Transformers, take a look at the making of the tanks for Hunger Games and stumble upon the iconic 1958 Chevy Impala from American Graffiti.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - BATTLE FOR ROME
programme.desc: One of the greatest battles in NASCAR history was Hall of Famer Richie Evans and rival speedster Jerry Cook. Ray is determined to uncover and revive the cars that made these men famous.Ray purchases one of Richie’s original #61 modifieds from Jimmy Spencer and restores it to its original glory while simultaneously building a replica of Jerry Cook’s #38. Throughout the build process, Ray uncovers stories about these legends through the eyes of guys who were in Rome, NY to witness it firsthand, like Robin Pemberton and Steve Hmiel.Both cars will hit the track at Martinsville, site of one of the greatest races in modified history and the tragic death of Richie Evans himself. Legends live again, as Ray recreates one of the racing world’s most celebrated rivalries on a track that has seen it all.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - HOT ROD HOLY GRAIL
programme.desc: While visiting the estate of automotive genius and land speed record holder Willie Glass, Ray uncovers a set of extremely rare Ardun cylinder heads, which is a hot rodders dream discovery. He also visits the infamous H & H Flatheads outside of Los Angeles and discovers a surprise connection to the Earnhardt family.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - SECRETS OF GM
programme.desc: General Motors VP of global design Ed Welburn takes AmeriCarna behind the scenes to talk about the history and development of the company’s concept cars that never made it to production. In a rare tour of the factory’s inner design studio, Ray gets an exclusive look behind the creative curtain at the GM plant in Detroit.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - CORVETTE SINK HOLE
programme.desc: A massive sinkhole opened underneath the National Corvette Museum in Kentucky. Eight amazing cars were swallowed up, including the 1,000,000th Corvette. AmeriCarna was given exclusive access to document the removal of the cars from the sinkhole and the painstaking restoration of the 1,000,000th Corvette.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - FIRST MUSTANG
programme.desc: In this episode, Ray celebrates the 50th birthday of the Ford Mustang through the lens of three distinct Mustang owners, who each hold a slice of the car’s incredible history. In 1964, Chicago schoolteacher Gail Wise unknowingly purchased the first ever Mustang 3 days before the car became available to the general public. Her husband reveals the incredible restoration that brought the earliest Mustang ever sold back to its 60’s glory. (Ford Motor Company knows she has the car and has verified it was sold before it was legal to sell.) John Grafelman is a farmer in Illinois and life-long Ford lover. A few years ago he found an old car hidden in a barn. It took some time, but he eventually convinced his friend to sell it to him. After some detective work, he discovers he purchased 1968 Ford Design Chief Larry Shinoda’s personal car that he tinkered with to invent the BOSS 302.Lastly, Ray travels to Dayton Ohio to interview Gale Holderman, the Ford stylist who won the company’s contest to draw and design the Mustang.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - ROAR AT THE SHORE
programme.desc: On the beaches of Wildwood, NJ, an iconic vintage race, The Race of Gentleman, takes place annually: period cars, period dress, pure authenticity. Ray puts a car in the race with a very special driver, who turns out not to be a Gentleman.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - CARS AND MUSIC STARS
programme.desc: Scott Borchetta, CEO and Founder of Big Machine Label Group, and his brother, Mark, love racing just as much as anyone. From Indy to Nashville, Ray finds he has a lot in common with the Borchetta brothers. This celebrity-filled episode features musicians Tim McGraw, Cassadee Pope and IndyCar driver Josef Newgarden.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - DRAGSTER DIPLOMACY
programme.desc: In 1964, the United States sent a star-studded race team to England to educate them on drag racing. On that team was Bob Keith and his Dos Palmas car. After being lost for over 40 years, Ray uncovers car and puts together a plan to reunite the two once more. The restoration of the car takes an emotional turn with the loss of a friend.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - SMOKIN JOE
programme.desc: Blues legend Joe Bonamassa is looking for a surprise gift for his parents. With his love of cars and guitars, Joe has to get Ray and Mr. H involved. From Mopar muscle to Mr. H’s man cave to a concert performance from Joe, this episode has a lot of Drive.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - BOARD TRACK BATTLES
programme.desc: In the early 1900s, race tracks built of wood sprang up across the country drawing crowds of 50,000 and more. Ray and Xtreme sports superstar Travis Pastrana break down the Battle on the Boards.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - MODEL T
programme.desc: Ray finds an old T-Bucket that made a 133 mph pass at the Bonneville Salt Flats in 1951. The team brings the Woody Lee T back to life and attempts to match its original speed.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - FORGOTTEN FIBERGLASS
programme.desc: Post-World War II, a large generation of American soldiers was looking for cars that mirrored the incredible sports cars they saw overseas in Europe. After searching for an affordable way to recreate these cars, one manufacturer responded with a durable, cost effective option: a line of fiberglass sports cars. Very few of these cars still exist but there are collectors who are constantly looking to save parts and pieces of these virtually unknown vehicles. We learn about these rare cars from Geoff Hacker and his team at Forgotten Fiberglass, and take a visit to the Smithsonian Museum, which houses a fiberglass car of its own. This episode presents a unique look at how the narrative of American wartime experiences often shaped the nation’s automotive demands.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - VINTAGE RACING
programme.desc: Ray uncovers the infamous “Brawner Hawk” – from the Dean Van Lines team – that became the breakout car in the career of Mario Andretti. Ray enlists HOF mechanic Jim McGee to restore the vehicle and, along the way, discovers a replica with many of the car’s original parts. After an award winning stop at Concours Amelia Island, the car heads to the 100th running of Indy 500 where Mario Andretti himself gets behind the wheel.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - MODEL T
programme.desc: Ray finds an old T-Bucket that made a 133 mph pass at the Bonneville Salt Flats in 1951. The team brings the Woody Lee T back to life and attempts to match its original speed.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - TWO JUNIORS
programme.desc: Dale Earnhardt Jr. wants Ray to help restore an El Camino, except add on a Laguna front end. It’s not a typical restoration, but it’s certainly a NASCAR performance-worthy restoration. Ray and the team build the car and then, in a bit of gamesmanship, challenge Kyle Tucker, owner of Detroit Speed, to a series of races against his award winning Camaro. But as always, Ray has an ace up his sleeve in Al Unser, Jr. as his driver.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - MACHINE MAGIC MARIO
programme.desc: In the late 60s, Camaros, Mustangs, and Corvettes roared to the forefront of the muscle car world. When Ray gets offered a spot in a vintage race featuring these cars, he’s propelled to dive into their history and afforded a chance to get behind the wheel at the Brickyard. But because it is a pro-am race, Ray pulls in a partner – none other than Bill Elliott, aka “Awesome Bill from Dawsonville.”

programme.title: AmeriCarna - HOLLYWOOD MAKEOVER
programme.desc: Everyone has a car they fell in love with. Maybe it was the first? Maybe it was the hot rod the guy down the street owned? In Ray’s case, it was the ’58 Chevy he saw in the iconic coming of age car movie, American Graffiti. When Ray gets the chance to own the car after years and years of pursuit, he jumps on it. But restoring the car to its "movie state" proves to be a grueling task that goes way beyond a typical build. But when it's you first love, you can't let her down.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - WOODIE WAGONS
programme.desc: The premiere episode features a dive into the influence cars had on culture of California. From road racing in the 1940’s to the inception of the iconic Woody wagon on the California beach scene, automobiles undoubtedly shaped the West Coast attitude. Ray talks to The Beach Boys frontman Mike Love and surfing icon Laird Hamilton for a glimpse into the cars that are so connected to surfing culture.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - MOONSHINE
programme.desc: Ray uncovers the secrets of America’s greatest racing sport in the foothills of North Carolina. When moonshiners were looking to outrun police officers, they would custom fit engines to race the back woods tracks. That sport eventually evolved into NASCAR and Ray talks to the early adopters of this national pastime.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - MARTY ROBBINS
programme.desc: Grammy-winning musician Marty Robbins lived a double life, flawlessly crossing between the glitz of the Grand Ole Opry and track at Talladega. One of few musicians to ever achieve success in both genres, Ray is determined to return Marty’s iconic 777 car to the race track travel back to the 60’s and 70’s.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - HOT RODS
programme.desc: Legendary drag racer Don “The Snake” Prudhomme proves he is no stranger to the thrill of racing rivalry. Prudhomme’s career and subsequent competition with driver Tom “The Mongoose” McEwan earned the pair an unforgettable imprint on American pop culture. Legions of kids in the 60’s and 70’s flocked to the shelves for Snake and Mongoose Matchbox cars which helped make drag racing an undisputable American pastime. Famed director Ron Howard makes an appearance to discuss the incredible stories hidden within the world of Formula 1 Racing, the topic of his latest, epic feature ‘Rush”.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - BURIED TREASURE
programme.desc: Ray finds Buried Treasures in the form of two race cars that had been left almost completely untouched since the last time they were on a race track. One is found sitting in a barn with the other trapped in an old car hauler. Upon uncovering the cars, we find both have big stories to tell.

It’s not a typical restoration, but it’s certainly a NASCAR performance-worthy restoration. Ray and the team build the car and then, in a bit of gamesmanship, challenge Kyle Tucker, owner of Detroit Speed, to a series of races against his award winning Camaro. But as always, Ray has an ace up his sleeve in Al Unser, Jr. as his driver.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - MACHINE MAGIC MARIO
programme.desc: In the late 60s, Camaros, Mustangs, and Corvettes roared to the forefront of the muscle car world. When Ray gets offered a spot in a vintage race featuring these cars, he’s propelled to dive into their history and afforded a chance to get behind the wheel at the Brickyard. But because it is a pro-am race, Ray pulls in a partner – none other than Bill Elliott, aka “Awesome Bill from Dawsonville.”

programme.title: AmeriCarna - HOLLYWOOD MAKEOVER
programme.desc: Everyone has a car they fell in love with. Maybe it was the first? Maybe it was the hot rod the guy down the street owned? In Ray’s case, it was the ’58 Chevy he saw in the iconic coming of age car movie, American Graffiti. When Ray gets the chance to own the car after years and years of pursuit, he jumps on it. But restoring the car to its "movie state" proves to be a grueling task that goes way beyond a typical build. But when it's you first love, you can't let her down.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - WOODIE WAGONS
programme.desc: The premiere episode features a dive into the influence cars had on culture of California. From road racing in the 1940’s to the inception of the iconic Woody wagon on the California beach scene, automobiles undoubtedly shaped the West Coast attitude. Ray talks to The Beach Boys frontman Mike Love and surfing icon Laird Hamilton for a glimpse into the cars that are so connected to surfing culture.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - MOONSHINE
programme.desc: Ray uncovers the secrets of America’s greatest racing sport in the foothills of North Carolina. When moonshiners were looking to outrun police officers, they would custom fit engines to race the back woods tracks. That sport eventually evolved into NASCAR and Ray talks to the early adopters of this national pastime.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - MARTY ROBBINS
programme.desc: Grammy-winning musician Marty Robbins lived a double life, flawlessly crossing between the glitz of the Grand Ole Opry and track at Talladega. One of few musicians to ever achieve success in both genres, Ray is determined to return Marty’s iconic 777 car to the race track travel back to the 60’s and 70’s.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - HOT RODS
programme.desc: Legendary drag racer Don “The Snake” Prudhomme proves he is no stranger to the thrill of racing rivalry. Prudhomme’s career and subsequent competition with driver Tom “The Mongoose” McEwan earned the pair an unforgettable imprint on American pop culture. Legions of kids in the 60’s and 70’s flocked to the shelves for Snake and Mongoose Matchbox cars which helped make drag racing an undisputable American pastime. Famed director Ron Howard makes an appearance to discuss the incredible stories hidden within the world of Formula 1 Racing, the topic of his latest, epic feature ‘Rush”.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - BURIED TREASURE
programme.desc: Ray finds Buried Treasures in the form of two race cars that had been left almost completely untouched since the last time they were on a race track. One is found sitting in a barn with the other trapped in an old car hauler. Upon uncovering the cars, we find both have big stories to tell.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - DAN GURNEY
programme.desc: Ray finds a Gurney Eagle in a garage on Long Island. He wants to put the coveted machine back on the track at Indy to honor Dan Gurney. After intense restoration and scouring the globe for a Gurney-Westlake engine, the Eagle soars again.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - VINTAGE RACING
programme.desc: Ray uncovers the infamous “Brawner Hawk” – from the Dean Van Lines team – that became the breakout car in the career of Mario Andretti. Ray enlists HOF mechanic Jim McGee to restore the vehicle and, along the way, discovers a replica with many of the car’s original parts. After an award winning stop at Concours Amelia Island, the car heads to the 100th running of Indy 500 where Mario Andretti himself gets behind the wheel.

But as always, Ray has an ace up his sleeve in Al Unser, Jr. as his driver.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - INDY RESCUE
programme.desc: A journey to Indianapolis unveils the winning car of the 1955 Indy 500 sits on the roof of an auto mechanic shop. More than 50 years after it’s magic at the track, prominent Indy mechanic/owner Chris Paulsen begins to restore the car and Ray talks about the evolution of America’s illustrious Indy 500.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: The first Grand Cherokee manufactured under the reign of Fiat is up for our test. The fourth generation of this classic looks much more elegant than before. Also: Opel's first electric family limousine, the Ampera. And: the Ssangyong Korrando.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: The new BMW One M Coupe from former race car driver Ralf Kelleners: the KS1 RS. Also: Toyota present their TS 030 hybrid at the 24-hours race of Le Mans. And: Subaru's XV crossover stands out from the company's model range.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: The 'little' Mercedes-Benz S250 with a four-cylinder engine needs so little fuel that one could call this car a piggybank. Also: the power packages Nissan 370 Z and Wiesmann GT MF5. And: the ADAC Eco Test.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: The new Porsche Boxter, a real open-top sports car. Also: Volkswagen presents the new Passat Alltrack, a real allrounder. And: Fiat's successful Panda model in its third generation version.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: Alfa Romeo present their Giulietta 2.0 model with new engines, a new TCR transmission and a minor facelift. Also: Mazda aim for compact SUV gold with the CX-5. And: the Mercedes-Benz E 300 BlueTEC Hybrid.

programme.title: Facel Vega Facellia
programme.desc: In the late 1950s, the Facel Vega Facellia was designed to compete with Porsche and Alfa Romeo and open a new market segment for the fledgling French luxury car company.

programme.title: Maserati Quattroporte GTS
programme.desc: 1963, over 50 years ago, with the Quattroporte Maserati invented a new vehicle category, the sports sedan. This GTS model is already the 6th generation of this iconic car.

programme.desc: Live from Athens, Greece on July 28, 2018, Karate Combat: Olympus is the second event of the Karate Combat fighting league's inaugural season. Other fighters include Deivis Ferraras of Dominican Republic, Wellington Barbosa of Brazil, and Yaser Sahintekin of Turkey.

programme.title: WPBL 2026 - Mumbai vs Rajasthan - Day 8 Tie 1
programme.desc: The atmosphere at Mumbai's Jio World Garden is electric as the host team, Mumbai Pickle Power, rides the momentum of their first season victory into a high-stakes clash against the Rajasthan Titans. With Rajasthan still hunting for their elusive first win of the season, the pressure is at a breaking point for both squads as they fight to climb the "Band of Honor" leaderboard. Witness tactical masterclasses as veteran Lorena Dupnik faces off against Jada Bui in a strategic battle of precision, and feel the intensity of the men's singles where superstars like Brandon Lane and Jack Foster showcase explosive athleticism. From game-changing "Pickle Plays" to high-stakes challenges and the presence of celebrity guests like Rishabh Pant, every rally in this tie is a desperate fight for survival on the road to the semifinals.

programme.title: Lock/Morris vs. Busson/Nguyen + Laville vs. Arnover
programme.desc: Live from the European Pickleball Championships 2025 in Rome, Italy, witness back-to-back high-stakes matchups. First, in Women's Doubles Open, Team England’s Thaddea Lock and Katie Morris face off against Team France’s Elodie Busson and Adeline Nguyen. In a "nip and tuck" group decider, both teams trade aggressive volleys and "shake and bake" attacks before England finds a tactical edge to break the deadlock.

programme.title: Women's Senior Singles Final - Linton vs. Tampieri
programme.desc: Witness one of the most exciting finals from the European Pickleball Championships 2025 in Rome. In the Women's Senior Singles Open Final, Team England’s Anna Linton takes on Team Italy’s Paola Tampieri at the iconic Stadio dei Marmi. Linton starts with commanding form, dominating the first game with powerful forehand drives. However, the momentum shifts as Tampieri, fueled by a passionate home crowd, adjusts her strategy to target Linton’s backhand and level the match.

programme.title: NCPA 2026 - University of Arizona vs. Univeristy of Colorado - Boulder
programme.desc: The NCPA Nationals reach a fever pitch in Saint Louis as the University of Arizona Wildcats and the CU Boulder Buffaloes go head-to-head in a high-stakes, best-of-seven showdown. This elite showcase features "smash mouth" pickleball, where powerhouses like Eileen Tran and Frida Madsen utilize aggressive "Skills" to dominate the kitchen line. The intensity explodes during the "Racing" pace of sudden-death points, forcing competitors into a tactical "Freestyle" battle of wills as they navigate a tight center court with no room for error. With the series tied and mixed doubles on the horizon, every serve carries the weight of a national title.

programme.desc: The stakes reach their absolute peak at Mumbai’s Jio World Garden for the first semifinal of the World Pickleball League Season 2, where there are "no do overs" for the Chennai Super Champs and Pune United. Witness a high-stakes tactical chess match as Chennai’s coach Jonny Goldberg makes the bold move to start premier player Rika Fujiwara against the "big and aggressive" Katie Morris in a critical women's singles clash. The intensity continues with a masterclass in mixed doubles featuring the powerful pairing of Lee Hwang Nam and Carlota Trevino facing off against Pune's consistent stars, William Sobeck and Magdalena Gregorio. Every point is a desperate grind for survival as these two titans battle through "world class" rallies for a guaranteed spot in the grand finale.

programme.title: Wisconsin vs. Ohio State
programme.desc: The hunt for a national bid reaches a fever pitch as the Wisconsin Badgers and Ohio State Buckeyes clash in the 2025 DUPR Collegiate Super Regional Finals. Every point carries the weight of a championship as these Midwest rivals trade blows across women’s, men’s, and mixed doubles divisions. With a ticket to the April National Championships on the line, the intensity culminates in a high-stakes Dream Breaker where individual grit determines which team reigns supreme.

programme.desc: Dylan Frazier and Ritchie Tuazon meet Irina Tereschenko and Connor Pardoe in a high-stakes mixed doubles match at Picklebowl 2023. Set against the backdrop of this annual charity event, the match features four seasoned competitors known for their precision, quick reflexes, and court awareness. Expect fast-paced exchanges, smart teamwork, and big momentum swings as both teams battle for bragging rights and a good cause. Blending professional play with the spirited energy of Picklebowl, this match is a crowd favorite you won’t want to miss.

programme.title: WPBL 2026 - Bengaluru vs Delhi - Day 4 Tie 2
programme.desc: The World Pickleball League Season 2 returns to the Jio World Garden in Mumbai for an electrifying Tie 8 showdown. The defending champions, Bengaluru Jawans—led by coach Oliver Strecker and backed by owners Atlee and Priya—return to the court for the first time since their dominant opening night performance. They face a determined Delhi Dilwale squad, coached by Wesley Gabrielsson, who are looking to climb the standings after a hard-fought tie-break victory in their previous outing.

programme.title: North Carolina vs. Utah Tech
programme.desc: The 2024 DUPR Collegiate National Championship reaches a fever pitch in Dallas as the North Carolina Tar Heels and the Utah Tech Trailblazers meet for a legendary semifinal rematch of their 2022 title bout. With both teams deeply familiar with one another’s strategies, the atmosphere at Brookhaven Country Club is electric, featuring elite players like Sarah Carpenter and Avery Beck battling for every point. The high-intensity matches, including women’s and men’s doubles, push these athletes to their limits as they fight to avoid another heart-pounding "dream breaker" finish. This high-stakes showdown captures the pure spirit of collegiate pickleball, where technical precision and emotional resilience decide who advances to face the defending champions.

programme.title: US Open 2025 - Mixed Pro Doubles - Kao/DeHeart vs. Fudge/Munro
programme.desc: Watch a thrilling Mixed Pro Doubles pickleball match between the top-seeded team of Megan Fudge and Jack Munro against Peichuan Kao and Ryler DeHeart. Megan Fudge is a highly-ranked professional player who previously played tennis at the University of Illinois, where she met her husband and partner, Ryler DeHeart. DeHeart is a former professional tennis player who is left-handed. Their opponents are Peichuan Kao, a professional pickleball player who won gold at the APP Fort Lauderdale Open, and Jack Munro, a young pro who was the youngest to become a professional at age 12.

programme.title: NCPA Virginia Beach Regional 2025 - Collegiate Team Match - Liberty vs. Carnegie Mellon
programme.desc: Live from Virginia Beach, this Week 3, Day 2 matchup of the NCPA Virginia Beach Regional 2025 features Liberty University facing Carnegie Mellon University. Liberty enters the match strong, having already secured wins in women's doubles. The broadcast highlights the Men's Doubles game where Liberty's Derek Kraje and Ben Rice dominate with a 11-6 victory, utilizing aggressive net play and strategic resets.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2023 - Men's Pro Split Doubles - Semifinal
programme.desc: Senior Pro’s Andre Mick & Jose Derisi battles against Altaf Merchant & John Cincola at the Naples, Florida.

programme.title: Picklebowl 2023 – Mixed Doubles Final – Yates & Wuerffel vs Bright & Hafez
programme.desc: In the exciting championship match of Picklebowl 2023, pro pickleball player Kyle Yates teams up with Picklebowl host and former NFL quarterback Danny Wuerffel to challenge the fierce duo of Anna Bright, a top female pro and former collegiate tennis star, and Ameen Hafez. This charity event brings together athletes and celebrities representing their alma maters in a competitive battle for the Picklebowl trophy. Commentary by Dave Fleming and special guest Marcellus Wiley highlights the skill, strategy, and drama on court. Watch intense rallies, strategic plays, and hear insider insights as these top players compete for the title. Don’t miss the dynamic energy and social spirit of pickleball in this must-see final.

programme.title: AFPL Stop 4 Championship Court - Game 3 - Old Town Bangers vs. Fort Myers Flamingos
programme.desc: This episode provides courtside commentary on Game 3 of the All Florida Pro League (AFPL) Stop 4 in Sarasota, Florida, featuring the Fort Myers Flamingos and the Old Town Bangers. The commentators highlight the aggressive play of newcomer Jada Bui and the defensive prowess of Ellie Schele. They also discuss the importance of mental toughness and team chemistry in a high-pressure environment. The episode concludes with a preview of the upcoming men's match.

programme.title: US Open 2023 – Wheelchair Hybrid Doubles 5.0 Gold Match – Krizmanich & Lipp vs Huletsky & Sylvestre
programme.desc: Don’t miss this inspiring wheelchair hybrid doubles match from the 2023 US Open Pickleball Championships. Adaptive athletes Rob Krizmanich, Michael Lipp, Patick Huletsky, and Jeff Sylvestre bring talent, teamwork, and tenacity to the court in a showcase of the sport’s inclusive future.

programme.title: Troubadour Club 2024 – Exhibition Match – Johnson & East vs Kennedy & Burrows
programme.desc: Set at the scenic Troubadour Golf and Field Club in Nashville, TN, this exhibition match brings a mix of celebrity flair and friendly competition to the pickleball court. Olympian Shawn Johnson and her husband Andrew East take on TV host Jason Kennedy and pro Wes Burrows in a lighthearted yet tightly contested match that goes down to the wire. With Shawn still learning the ropes (and the rules), and Andrew channeling his athletic instincts, the duo puts up an impressive fight against the more experienced Kennedy and Burrows. It’s a fast-paced, fun-filled match full of laughs, learning moments, and great rallies—perfect for fans of lifestyle sports and celebrity matchups.

programme.title: NCPA 2026 - Utah Valley University vs. Louisiana State University
programme.desc: The atmosphere at the Arch Pickleball Center reaches a fever pitch as Utah Valley and LSU clash in a high-stakes, sudden-death battle for survival. This elite matchup showcases the "Racing" speed of Ethan Martin against the tactical "Skills" of Rachel Gauff in a contest where every point determines who advances in the bracket. With a $1,000 bounty on the line, both teams engage in a fierce "Freestyle" display of collegiate athleticism that proves why new powerhouses are emerging on the national stage.

programme.title: WPBL 2026 - Delhi vs Bengaluru - Day 12 Tie 2
programme.desc: The road to the championship reaches a fever pitch at Mumbai's Jio World Garden for the second semifinal of the World Pickleball League Season 2. In this high-stakes "penultimate tie," the defending champion Bengaluru Jawans face off against a hungry Delhi Dilwale squad led by coach Wesley Gabrielsson. Witness a clash of styles as the dominant Katerina Stewart, who has lost only one match all season, battles the passionate Alejandra Lopez in a critical women's singles opener. Tactical brilliance is on full display as Max Mantor and Trang Huynh attempt to dismantle the Jawans' defense in a high-scoring mixed doubles "exhibition". With every strategic "Pickle Play" and intense baseline rally potentially deciding who advances to the grand finale, the atmosphere is electric and the margins for error are razor-thin.
